title: Basic Use
text: canhrcolors() returns full palette hex codes. Give one color names get just colors.

title: Basic Use
text: scale_color_canhr() scale_fill_canhr() color groups palette order, theme_canhr() styles titles, text grid lines. examples use data come R ggplot2.

title: Basic Use
text: Highway mileage engine size mpg data, colored drive type.
code: ggplot(mpg, aes(displ, hwy, color = drv)) +   geom_point(size = 2.5) +   scale_color_canhr(labels = c("4WD", "Front", "Rear")) +   theme_canhr() +   labs(     title = "Fuel economy by engine size",     x = "Engine displacement (litres)",     y = "Highway miles per gallon",     color = "Drive"   )

title: Basic Use
text: Number cars class mpg data.
code: ggplot(mpg, aes(class, fill = class)) +   geom_bar(show.legend = FALSE) +   scale_fill_canhr() +   theme_canhr() +   labs(title = "Cars by class", x = NULL, y = "Number of cars")

title: Basic Use
text: Petal length three species iris data.
code: ggplot(iris, aes(Species, Petal.Length, fill = Species)) +   geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE) +   scale_fill_canhr() +   theme_canhr() +   labs(title = "Petal length by species", x = NULL, y = "Petal length (cm)")

title: Basic Use
text: Use single color name. Minutes Old Faithful eruptions faithful data. plot needs colors palette gets warning draws extra groups grey.
code: ggplot(faithful, aes(waiting)) +   geom_histogram(binwidth = 2, fill = canhrcolors("blue"), color = "white") +   theme_canhr() +   labs(     title = "Time between Old Faithful eruptions",     x = "Minutes",     y = "Number of eruptions"   )

title: Basic Use
text: colors work anywhere R accepts color. Petal width petal length iris data, drawn base R.
code: pal <- canhrcolors()[1:3] plot(Petal.Width ~ Petal.Length, data = iris, col = pal[Species], pch = 19,      xlab = "Petal length (cm)", ylab = "Petal width (cm)") legend("topleft", legend = levels(iris$Species), col = pal, pch = 19, bty = "n")

title: Stata Usage
text: Install canhr scheme GitHub: Running command updates existing installation. install hand instead, copy scheme-canhr.scheme s folder PLUS directory. Type sysdir Stata see ; Windows usually C:\ado\plus\s\.
code: net install canhr, from("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rdazadda/CANHR-color-schemes/main/") replace

title: Stata Usage
text: make default future sessions:
code: set scheme canhr set scheme canhr, permanently
